translation: It is named from the Belt Vessel being diseased, and also named from the form of the disease; white belongs to qi, red belongs to blood. It is mostly caused by drunkenness, overeating, and sexual overexertion, and by taking dry and hot foods. There are also cases of damp phlegm flowing and lodging in the lower burner, and of kidney and liver yin with damp excess; or from fright and fear causing wood to encroach on the earth position, with turbid fluid flowing downward; or from boundless longing, developing into sinew flaccidity, what is called disease of the two yangs arising in the heart and spleen; or from damp-heat of the remaining channels, bent and stagnating below the lower abdomen; or from vacuity and cold of the lower origin, with damp excess of the uterus. The methods of treating it are either to purge downward or to vomit, or to supplement within the midst of dispersing, to promote urination within the midst of supplementing, to raise and disperse within the midst of drying, to warm and nourish within the midst of moistening, or to warm and strengthen, or to astringe; the various examples differ, and this is also the living method of disease mechanism.
